text: That last demonstration would now seem difficult to beat for Shichimi!
...come on Shichimi, everyone's waiting for you.
It seems, Ladies & Gentlemen that Shichimi forfeits...
I... I did not know we had to give a demonstration.
I cannot, it is too dangerous SORRY!

...and stop
pretending to be shy,
you're spoiling
the show.

Everyone already knows
that I've won the contest
no matter what your
potion does...
CAREFUL!!! It's a potion for GIANT MONSTERS!
